description: Mechanically-mergeable project-file overlap (issue #643). Both radii cite the same QuickFiler.Test.csproj alongside a source file of their own. The .csproj matches the configured **/*.csproj pattern, so it is dropped from both collections immediately before the smallest-path-overlap computation and the remaining source files are disjoint. The paths themselves are unchanged in the radius records; only the comparison sees the filtered collections.
